doc: The ONE movement and feel tuning file (owner 11-08), read by scripts/core/locomotion.gd (Loco) for the farm avatar and every match hunter alike. Live: with the movement readout open (F7, or Settings > Controls), saving this file re-reads it within poll_s. Units: m, s, m/s, m/s^2; drags are 1/s (the share of the excess lost per second, exponential). air: accel = how hard WASD pushes in the air; counter = multiplier on accel for the part of your speed going against the keys (a backward drift turns forward in ~0.1 s); side = multiplier for the part going across the keys (bends the arc); drag = how fast speed above your run cap (dash, knock, launch) bleeds in the air; idle_drag = what a jump with no keys loses per second. glide: accel = the glider's pull toward where you steer at or under cruise; turn / turn_fast = deg/s at cruise and the share kept at the max; brake / brake_deg = pulling back past this angle brakes this hard; drag = how fast speed above cruise bleeds with no keys (back to cruise in ~1.5 s), drag_steer = the same while steering; coast = m/s^2 a let-go under cruise slows; catch = m/s^2 the canopy eases a fall to its sink rate (absorbed, never turned into speed); max = the fastest a glide carries. glide_carry: per hunter, speed above this carried from Shift into a glide bleeds at carry_drag (on top of drag), so a dash never turns into a long sprint. dash.jump_keep: the share of a ground dash's speed a jump out of it keeps (the rest is air drag's, Loco.air_step; 1 = all of it, a long dash-jump). dash_ease: per hunter, a dash's speed scale (its time stretches so the distance stays) and how much it eases in and out (0 = flat; 0.25 = starts and ends at 75% of its average, peaks at 125%).
